attestations.text: Yang Shang-wên 楊尚文 (T. 墨林), likewise a native of Shansi, Chang Mu edited the 連筠簃叢書 Lien-yün i ts'ung-shu which was printed in the years 1847–48. This collectanea contains 12 works, including the first reprint of the important source on the early history of the Mongols, entitled Yüan-ch'ao pi-shih (see under Ku Kuang-ch'i).
